description:
One row of a store report (a product, a day, a status, a way to get
the order), or the report's total. One model for every kind: a field a
kind does not count is null.

label.description: What the row counts: the product name, the UTC+8 day (YYYY-MM-DD), the status, pickup or delivery, or "total"
label.title: Label

units.description: Units in those orders; null when the kind does not count them
units.title: Units

revenue.description: What they sold for, in the currency; null when the kind does not count it
revenue.title: Revenue

deliveryFees.description: The delivery fees in that revenue; null when the kind does not count them
deliveryFees.title: Deliveryfees

title: StoreReportRow
